SELECT CustomerId,bcl.LocationId,bloc.LocationAddressLine1,bloc.LocationAddressLine2, convert(varchar(8000),BCL.LocationId,1) FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation BCL
JOIN BNKM.Location BLOC ON convert(varchar(8000),BCL.LocationId,1) = convert(varchar(8000),BLOC.LocationId,1)

SELECT CustomerId,bcl.LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation BCL
where convert(varchar(8000),BCL.LocationId,1) = '0xACB5639966E9652D6B5B9B894EDFE7E2'

SELECT LEN ('0xACB5639966E9652D6B5B9B894EDFE7E2')

select CustomerId, LocationId from BNKM.CustomerLocation where CustomerId = 'R02673624' and LocationTypeId = 'y'
